title: 1hohoky
Ghadir Khumm
hook: In the middle of the desert the caravan halted. A hand was raised into the air. On that day the wilayah of Imam Ali was proclaimed.
scenes.0.text: The farewell pilgrimage was over. The Prophet was returning to Medina from Mecca with a large group of pilgrims. **Ali**, who came from Yemen and joined him on the Hajj, was also in the caravan. The camels were moving slowly through the hot desert, and people were telling each other about the excitement of their pilgrimage days. Many were now counting on returning home. The Prophet had something important to say to his people on the way back. The first verse of the Maide Surah begins: "Communicate what has been revealed to you from your Lord". When the caravan reached a body of water called Ghadir Hum near Khufa, the Prophet ordered it to stop.
scenes.0.art.actors.1.label: 19izoul
The Prophet
scenes.0.art.actors.2.label: lhg99z
Imam Ali
scenes.1.text: Hum was a small pond in the middle of the desert and surrounded by a few trees. The roads of the returnees from Mecca used to part here. Some went to Medina, some to Iraq, some to Yemen. **The Prophet** asked that those who went ahead be called back and those who stayed behind be waited. The heat of the afternoon was scorching, and people tried to take shelter in the shade of the trees. Rumours vary as to the number of those gathered, but they all speak of a large crowd. When the crowd gathered, the Prophet began to preach and everyone was silent to hear his voice.
scenes.1.art.actors.1.label: 19izoul
The Prophet
scenes.2.text: This was the most crowded speech the Prophet gave after his Farewell Discourse. There were over 100,000 people gathered there for the return of the Hajj. The Prophet began his speech with a question: "Am I not nearer to the believers than their own selves?" The crowd answered in unison, "Yes, O Messenger of Allah". This question was no ordinary introduction. The Prophet first affirmed his position and his right over the people before everyone. He made the believers admit that they had more say in the matter than they did. Shia recitation places particular emphasis on this order. Because the word that followed immediately would reveal who would continue to have that nearness and authority. The crowd waited for the Prophet's next words.
scenes.2.art.actors.1.label: 19izoul
The Prophet
scenes.3.text: Then the Prophet took **Ali**'s hand and lifted it up so that everyone could see it. A thousand eyes turned to those two hands. The Prophet said, "Whoever I am his guardian, Ali is his guardian". Some narratives follow this prayer: "O Allah, love him who loves him, and be his enemy who hates him". The word "**mevlâ**" is understood in different ways. Some saw him as a friend, others as a master and leader. The Shia recitation reads the word along with the question the Prophet just asked. The Prophet first acknowledged his closeness and authority to the people, then gave the same closeness and authority to Ali. The Shiites call this ilaha waliyyat, or the leadership of Ali.
scenes.3.art.actors.1.label: 19izoul
The Prophet
scenes.3.art.actors.2.label: lhg99z
Imam Ali
scenes.4.text: In the same speech, he said that the Prophet left two heavy commitments to the Ummah. One of them was the Book of God, and the other was the People of the House. He said, "These two will not separate until they come to me at the pool". The pool is the pool of the Day of Judgment. The prophet did not merely give this warning once; he repeated it several times. In the hadith, the word "Itret" means the immediate family of the Prophet. So anyone who wanted to understand the Qur'an correctly should not separate him from the Prophet's family. These words were written in memory of the pilgrims who were to be scattered to their homes. And they carried it into the cities and villages and tents where they went.
scenes.4.art.actors.1.label: 19izoul
The Prophet
scenes.4.art.actors.2.label: lhg99z
Imam Ali
scenes.5.text: When the speech was over, people came to congratulate **Ali**. Umar was among the congratulators. Umar said to Ali, "Congratulations, O son of Abu Talib, you have become the protector of all believing men and women". The crowd shook hands with Ali for a long time. Then the caravans set out again and the pilgrims dispersed from Hum to their homes. About two and a half months after this incident, the Prophet died. Some of those who congratulated Ali in Ghadir gathered in Sakife before the Prophet's funeral was washed. There's no mention of Ali.
scenes.5.art.actors.2.label: lhg99z
Imam Ali
scenes.6.text: Ghadir Hum was not the only thing the Prophet said about Ali. He had given him his flag at Khaybar and introduced him as a lover of Allah and His Messenger, loved by them. He left Ali in Medina when he was on his way to Tabuk and said to him, "Be to me as Aaron was to Moses". And in Ghadir Hum, he raised her hand in front of the crowd returning from the Hajj. These three events occurred in different years, but they all pointed to the same person. Years later, when Sahabi Sa'd b. Abi Wakkas, the Mu'awiya, asked him why he didn't curse Ali, he would answer by listing these three virtues.
scenes.6.art.actors.0.label: lhg99z
Imam Ali
sunni.0.says: From Zayd b. Arqam: "Whoever I am his mawla, Imam Ali is also his mawla."
sunni.1.says: Sa'd b. Abi Waqqas reminds Mu'awiya of three virtues of Imam Ali: the mawla saying, the Manzila, and the Khaybar banner.
sunni.2.says: The report that mentions Ghadir Khumm by name; the sermon and the taking of Imam Ali's hand; Umar's congratulation also appears in this report.
sunni.2.grade: Arna'ut: sahih li-ghayrihi; Ali b. Zayd in the chain is weak
sunni.3.says: The sermon at the water called Khumm: "I am leaving among you two weighty things: the Book of God and my Ahl al-Bayt."
sunni.4.says: The Book and the 'itra (Ahl al-Bayt) will not be separated until they reach the Prophet at the Hawd.
sunni.5.says: The Manzila hadith: "You are to me as Harun was to Musa."
sunni.6.says: The Manzila hadith; Mu'awiya says to Sa'd, "Why do you not curse Imam Ali?", and Sa'd lists three virtues of Imam Ali.
sunni.7.says: The flag at Khaybar is given to whoever loves Allah and His Messenger, whoever is loved by them.
sunni.8.says: Many chains of the Ghadir hadith are included in the Mustadrak.
shia.0.says: Reports on the Ghadir event and on the wilayah of Imam Ali.
shia.1.says: The account of the event; Umar's congratulation is also related.
shia.2.says: A work compiling the Companion, Successor and scholar narrators and the literature of the Ghadir hadith.
shia.3.says: They relate that the verse "Convey what has been sent down to you from your Lord" was revealed at Ghadir concerning Imam Ali.
disputes.0.title: yb4gkl
What does "Mawla" mean?
disputes.0.sunni: At Ghadir Khumm the Prophet raised Imam Ali's hand and said, "Whoever I am his mawla, Imam Ali is also his mawla." In the Sunni reading, mawla means friend, helper and supporter; the sermon exalts Imam Ali after the complaints about him and does not explicitly state the caliphate.
disputes.0.shia: At Ghadir Khumm the Prophet raised Imam Ali's hand and said, "Whoever I am his mawla, Imam Ali is also his mawla." In the Shia reading, mawla is tied to the question "Am I not awla over the believers than their own selves?" and means leadership; the caravan's halt in the desert also shows the weight of the proclamation.
disputes.1.title: 11xvhm2
When did Maide 3 land?
disputes.1.sunni: "Today I have perfected your religion". In the Sunni recitation, the verse, Buhari, descended on Arafat on Friday, as stated in the Sahih in the news from Umar.
disputes.1.shia: The verse "Today I have perfected your religion for you" is in Mâide 3. In the Shia reading, the same verse was revealed at Ghadir, with the proclamation of Imam Ali's wilayah.
questions.0: The Prophet stopped thousands in the hot desert and raised Ali's hand. Why do you think the Prophet made this announcement by stopping the crowd from returning from the Hajj?
questions.1: He said: "Am I not nearer to the believers than themselves?" Why do you think the Prophet asked that question before the word "mevla"?
questions.2: And the People of the House were entrusted with the Book. Why do you think the Prophet entrusted the Book and the Ahl al-Bayt together in his speech announcing Ali's succession?
questions.3: Sa'd b. When the Mu'awiya asked him why he had not cursed Ali, the Mu'awiya counted his word, the Manzile and the Khyber banner. Why do you think Sa'd responded with these words of the Prophet when he refused to insult?
summary: At Ghadir Khumm the Prophet raised Imam Ali's hand and said, "Whoever I am his mawla, Imam Ali is also his mawla"; this was the proclamation of his wilayah.
key: Imam Ali's right of wilayah: «Whoever I am his mawla, Imam Ali is also his mawla»
notes.0: Ghadir Khumm took place at the waters of Khumm on the return from the Farewell Pilgrimage.
notes.1: Ghadir Khumm is remembered as the second largest gathering assembled around the Prophet after the Farewell Pilgrimage.
notes.2: The number of participants is reported in sources to be over one hundred thousand; some sources say 114 thousand and 124 thousand.
notes.3: The Prophet raised Imam Ali's hand and said «Whoever I am his mawla, Imam Ali is also his mawla».
notes.4: In the Ja'fari school, mawla means leader, tied to the awla question in the sermon; Ghadir is the proclamation of Imam Ali's wilayah.
